system.biography: Malicious wood elementals lurking in tree branches overhanging roads, leading travelers astray to exhaust, bind in cocoons of wood and leaves and inject with petrifying poison. Bodies are tight bundles of branches with eight jointed limbs. Consummate liars with venomous words.
